title: Topic Solr Document
description: Schema for topic description documents in Solr (Impresso Project)

id.description: Unique identifier for the topic (format: model_id_tp{number}_{lang})

word_probs_dpf.description: Word probabilities in DPFS format (space-separated pairs of 'word|probability')

topic_suggest.description: Space-separated list of topic words for suggestion/autocomplete

topic_type_s.description: Topic category assigned by the label-generation model (e.g. 'advertisement', 'legal_administrative') — topic labels v3. Optional: absent on pre-v3 topic-description-only documents.

label_short_s.description: Short human-readable topic label — topic labels v3. Optional: absent on pre-v3 topic-description-only documents.

label_long_txt_en.description: Long-form English topic label/description, analyzed text — topic labels v3. Optional: absent on pre-v3 topic-description-only documents.

confidence_s.description: Confidence level of the generated label — topic labels v3. Optional: absent on pre-v3 topic-description-only documents.

representative_terms_ss.description: Representative terms backing the generated topic label — topic labels v3. Optional: absent on pre-v3 topic-description-only documents.

generated_by_s.description: Attribution for the topic-label generation process (e.g. 'OpenAI') — topic labels v3. Optional: absent on pre-v3 topic-description-only documents.
